dialogues.speaker: Shcheglov
dialogues.text: Of course, my friend. Although the consists in Snezhnaya look identical at first glance, you can still spot minor variations between the various series if you look closely.

dialogues.speaker: Shcheglov
dialogues.text: This consist is from the third production series... You can tell because when we are underway, the sound of the wheel tires is a little lighter.
